description: This file defines the TestRunContainer class, which implements a Container interface to run JUnit-based tests within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages initializing test suites, executing tests, handling results, generating reports, and logging outcomes.

classes.name: TestRunContainer
classes.description: A container implementation for running JUnit tests within the OFBiz framework, managing test execution, reporting, and logging.

classes.name: JunitXmlListener
classes.description: A listener class for formatting and writing JUnit test results to XML files.

classes.name: JunitListener
classes.description: A listener for capturing test errors, failures, start, and end events during test execution and logging them.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with provided startup commands, creates log directory, extracts test properties, sets log level, and prepares test suite wrapper.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes all prepared test suites, logs results, handles failures, and throws exception if tests fail.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping the container (no implementation).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this container instance.

methods.name: setLoggerLevel
methods.description: Configures debug log levels based on specified log level string.

methods.name: prepareJunitSuiteWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a JunitSuiteWrapper based on test properties; throws exception if no tests are found.

methods.name: createJunitXmlListener
methods.description: Creates a JunitXmlListener that writes test results to a specified XML file.

methods.name: logTestSuiteResults
methods.description: Logs summary and error details of test suite execution.

methods.name: logErrorsOrFailures
methods.description: Logs individual test errors or failures.
